label: TEST: CX-8 rig and local test stack only. Not an owner decision and not a product default.

INDEXER_START_HEIGHT.note: TEST: the local TEST chain starts empty, so the explorer indexes it from genesis. Blank in production refuses boot.

INDEXER_FINALITY_DEPTH.note: TEST finality depth on the local TEST chain (one block a second). Blank in production refuses boot.

INDEXER_BATCH_SIZE.note: TEST blocks per ingest pass on the local TEST chain. Blank in production refuses boot.

INDEXER_EXPLORER_LIST_LIMIT.note: TEST explorer page size. Blank in production refuses indexer.explorer_list_limit_unset.

INDEXER_TX_DROP_WINDOW_SECONDS.note: TEST window before an unseen pending hash reads dropped. Blank in production refuses indexer.tx_drop_window_unset.
